senseNotes.cuadro: Framed painting teaching sense, but Spanish cuadro also identifies unframed canvas painting. Exclude painter/gallery components; do not treat magazine/postcard photos as framed paintings.
senseNotes.paleta: Painter palette only; exact reused Japanese five-paint-well palette. No popsicle/spatula sense implied.
senseNotes.tocar: Playing an instrument only; guitarist and concert/festival instrumentalists genuinely compete. Do not treat every hand/object contact as tocar.
senseNotes.escuchar: Explicit headphones-and-notes action. Kiku pictures compete with audífonos noun, but unrelated eating/spatial actions need not all count as escuchar.
senseNotes.cerámica: Decorative pottery/craftware grouping of vase/jar/bowl. Do not blanket-exclude cups/plates based on inferred ceramic material; selected object shapes differ.
senseNotes.pintar-vs-dibujar: Brush at colored upright canvas vs graphite pencil on flat uncolored paper clearly distinguish approved actions; retain as possible distractors.
